description: AGSC-01-39: what the SKOS import cannot carry is dropped, and each dropped statement is one AGSC-E506 warning naming its subject and predicate. Derivation over the file of imp-0006 with Cat changed: a second prefLabel in French (dropped; the English one is the title), a notation, a scope note, a skos:exactMatch to another thesaurus, a skos:broader whose object ex:missing is no concept of the file, and a definition now long enough (70 code points) to be the description; and ex:Thing, an owl:Class, which is none of concept, scheme or collection and whose one statement is dropped. Six dropped statements and three draft warnings, nine AGSC-E506 in all, no error. The broader Link keeps animal only; the items are those of imp-0006 except that cat has the description and an empty body.
